scope: two visually reviewed actual diagnostic frames only
limitations: PNG display-code color heuristics, NOT exact ray counters, linear radiance, phase-matched before/after, full sequence or appearance acceptance. Yellow/orange and purple/pink intentionally remain combined. Neutral classification can include other branches.
classification: dominant channel >80 and >3x others; bright neutral min>130 and max<1.4min; non-TIR not counted as rejection
